Theorem
[Soul theorem and soul conjecture] Source: chow-et-al-ricci-flow-part-iii:page-0484 ↗ def:chow-iii-i20-i21-soul ↗ prop:chow-iii-i12-i17-busemann-convexity 1. appi:1.22,appi:1.23\group Soul theory

If $\sect (g)\ge 0$, a complete noncompact $\M $ has a soul $S$ and is diffeomorphic to $\nu (S)$; any two souls are isometric. If $\sect (g)>0$, every soul is a point. More generally, nonnegative sectional curvature with positive sectional curvature somewhere forces the soul to be a point.
